{{Quote|I don't think we can protect two transports at a time.|[[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|General Rieekan]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''GR-75 medium transport''', also known as the '''Gallofree medium transport''' or '''Rebel transport''', was a clamshell-hulled [[Transport/Legends|transport]] produced by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] Many of these transports served the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including playing a pivotal role in the evacuation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:GR75transport_schem.jpg|thumb|left|GR-75 schematics]]
A sister design to the civilian [[GR-45 medium transport/Legends|GR-45 model]], the GR-75 was used by freight drivers and shipping firms to haul cargo.

The transport's outer hull was like a thick shell with the interior entirely open for [[Cargo pod/Legends|cargo pods]]. This open-space design could fit up to 19,000 metric tons of cargo into the 90 meter long ship. Modular cargo pods greatly sped up the loading and unloading process.

When the transport was at its cargo capacity, a magnetic [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] locked the modules in place, while at the same time kept out the vacuum of space. The factory model included space for forty passengers, but almost all ships traded it for increased cargo storage.

{{IBI|File:GR-75 underside btm.jpg|GR-75 ventral surface, showing cargo pods}}
Focused entirely on maximizing cargo space, GR-75 transports were armed with four turreted twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], a deflector shield produced by the shield generator pod above the stern,<ref name="chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> a meager Class 4 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engine]] array capable of achieving a top atmospheric speed of 650 kilometers per hour. While inexpensive, the GR-75 was notorious for its high maintenance requirements.

Some of these transports were used as shuttles for high ranking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] personnel.

==History==
The design proved popular with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces, and the ships were used as resupply vessels during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

[[File:GR-75_transport_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A GR-75 medium transport takes off from Hoth.]]
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used at least one known unit, the ''[[Shackles of Nizon]]'', which saw service as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] ship.<ref name="The Queen of Air and Darkness" />

Many GR-75 transports were acquired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] due to their low cost and ready access to spare parts. The transports had hulls impenetrable by Imperial sensors and were additionally equipped with sensor jammers, thus reducing the chances of Imperials detecting Rebel supply runs.<ref name="chronicles" /> Not intended for combat, GR-75s were commonly placed at the center of Alliance fleet formations and relied on starfighter support in blockade-running missions. After Gallofree Yards went bankrupt in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the majority of the remaining stock of ships found its way into the Alliance fleet.

Several GR-75 transports were part of a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The fleet was [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|attacked]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was trying to capture [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. The fleet then jumped to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] on the order of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] to [[Assault on Kamino|take out]] the [[Timira City Cloning Facility]]. After the battle, several GR-75s were used as decoys while the imprisoned [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was taken to the [[Dantooine base/Legends|Dantooine base]] aboard the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]''<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

One of the most famous actions performed by GR-75s was the [[Bright Hope/Legends#Running the gauntlet|evacuation of Rebel personnel]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. More than half of the GR-75s were destroyed, as the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|blockade]] proved too much for the Rebel defenses, though thirteen escaped safely, due to the escort afforded by the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], as well as the covering fire provided by the [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|V-150 anti-orbital ion cannon]].

[[File:LieutenantKarsabi-SWZ.png|thumb|right|270px|A Rebel GR-75 comes under attack from an Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]].]]
The Alliance used the GR-75s for almost any purpose they could find and the ships became so ubiquitous that they became commonly known as '''Rebel medium transports'''. They were primarily used to transport supplies, equipment, and troops. Some were modified to be [[Tanker/Legends|fuel tankers]] for long range [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] missions or for smaller ships. They also were used as kamikaze vessels, as demonstrated during the [[Fondor shipyard assault|assault on the Fondor shipyards]]<ref name="SW:RSIII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], where they functioned as fire ships and were loaded with explosives.<ref name="ROTJn">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' (novel)]]</ref>

Several vessels fell into the hands of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] who used them to land troops and attack vehicles on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] for the [[Ground Battle on Hypori]].

At least one GR-75 was used to make up a secret retreat in [[137 ABY]],<ref name="SWL25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> and several were used during the [[Evacuation of Dac]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Expandsect}}
The GR-75 first appeared with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and its tie-ins.

The GR-75 has been re-imagined in LEGO form with the release of ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]''.
